plain_english: Even a moment parted from You, Lord — of me burning dense always — may I be the ground of Your gaze.
sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama | nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam

plain_english: In saṃsāra whose essence is parting — by You, dear Lord, may I be ever unparted, though parted from the world.
sanskrit_cite: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā | aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ

plain_english: Wherever I go by body, speech, mind — all that is You alone: may this ultimate truth stand ever full for me.
sanskrit_cite: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat | ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā

plain_english: As You are construction-free, great-bliss-full — so may my praise-speech become, just fitting.
sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā | bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama

plain_english: Seeing thing after thing as consisting of You, by Your possession — may I roam desireless, joy-filled.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam | vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ

plain_english: May I see the whole world full of Your being, Lord — by that alone content; then do not toil.
sanskrit_cite: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat | tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase

plain_english: May things shine for me always, melting into You alone like cloud-bits in sky, moving toward ever-purer courses.
sanskrit_cite: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva | bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ

plain_english: May there blaze for me, from Your middle, some jewel of Being — its self-light-spread destroying the endless dark-series.
sanskrit_cite: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ | santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ

plain_english: What stage do You not rule, what could there be that is not Your body? Tired — by effortlessness may I reach You everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ | śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām

plain_english: May limb-embrace-enjoyment with You happen to me by mere will — this much gained, Lord, what have I not won?
sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me | ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā

plain_english: Appear! We make no other prayers miserable — we languish, seeking only You.
sanskrit_cite: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ | kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe
